episodeTitle.en: How Intercom rose from the ashes by betting everything on AI | Eoghan McCabe (founder and CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: Intercom如何从灰烬中崛起，押注一切于AI | Eoghan McCabe（创始人兼首席执行官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Eoghan McCabe is the founder and CEO of Intercom, a customer service platform that has successfully pivoted to become an AI-first company with its agent product, Fin. After stepping away from the CEO role in 2020 due to health issues, Eoghan returned to find the company’s growth had stalled. Just one month after his return, ChatGPT launched, and within six weeks, Intercom had a working prototype of what would become Fin. In this conversation, Eoghan shares the brutal reality of transforming a late-stage SaaS business valued at multiple billions into an AI-first company that’s now growing faster than most public software companies. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: Eoghan McCabe是Intercom的创始人兼首席执行官，Intercom是一家客户服务平台，成功转型为以AI为先的公司，推出了其代理产品Fin。在2020年因健康问题卸任CEO职位后，Eoghan回归时发现公司的增长停滞。就在他回归的一个月后，ChatGPT发布，六周内，Intercom就开发出了Fin产品的原型。在这次对话中，Eoghan分享了将一家价值数十亿美元的晚期SaaS公司转型为以AI为先的公司的残酷现实。*我们讨论了：*

title.en: How Intercom rose from the ashes by betting everything on AI | Eoghan McCabe (founder and CEO)
title.zh: Intercom如何从灰烬中崛起，押注一切于AI | Eoghan McCabe（创始人兼首席执行官）

summary.en: Eoghan gets brutally honest about transforming Intercom into an AI-first company after growth nearly went negative, describing how he declared a 'wartime' mode and rewrote the company's values to cut out what wouldn't work in an AI era. He recounts pushing through intense resistance—including a soft coup attempt and roughly 40% staff turnover—to bet everything on Fin, an AI agent that hit eight figures in ARR within quarters. His core message: AI will disrupt your industry violently, so you must disrupt yourself first, and that requires a founder willing to make brave, hard decisions and own the results.
summary.zh: Eoghan 毫无保留地讲述了在增长几乎转负后，如何将 Intercom 转型为 AI 优先的公司：他宣布进入“战时”状态，并重写公司价值观，以剔除在 AI 时代不再有效的部分。他回顾了顶住巨大阻力（包括一次“软性政变”和约 40% 的人员更替）押注 Fin 的过程——这个 AI 智能体在几个季度内就达到八位数 ARR。他的核心观点是：AI 将以最猛烈的方式颠覆你的行业，所以你必须先自我革命，而这需要一个愿意做出勇敢、艰难决定并承担结果的创始人。
